messages.text:
"Create a highly realistic medical doctor simulator game. The gameplay focuses on accurate clinical diagnosis, patient interaction, and detailed treatment management.
Key features to include:
• Realistic Diagnostics: Patients present with detailed case histories and complex physical symptoms. Players must perform standard examinations, check vitals, and order specific diagnostic tests (such as Complete Blood Count, Comprehensive Metabolic Panel, X-rays, MRI, and CT scans) with realistic values and ranges.
• Extensive Condition Database: Include at least 20+ distinct medical conditions across cardiovascular, respiratory, gastrointestinal, neurological, and infectious diseases (e.g., acute appendicitis, bacterial pneumonia, myocardial infarction, type 2 diabetes ketoacidosis, and bacterial meningitis).
• Multiple Comprehensive Treatments: For each condition, provide at least three distinct treatment options, covering immediate emergency stabilization, targeted pharmacological interventions (antibiotics, antivirals, specific dosages), surgical procedures, and long-term lifestyle management or rehabilitation.
• Dynamic Patient Outcome: Patient health metrics change in real-time based on the accuracy and speed of the player's choices. Incorrect prescriptions or delayed treatments result in specific clinical complications or deterioration.
• User Interface: Clean, dark-themed professional medical dashboard displaying patient charts, live vitals monitor, a searchable diagnostic tool lab, and an active treatment prescription pad.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
